description: Election Commission - Declare that A. S. L. de Silva was Selected as the member of the Kalutara P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a new member to fill the vacant seat, making it clearly related to electoral administration under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
